rebuild_on_write.about: implementation rebuilds the state on every write; quick_check at the exit batch refuses it (the differential sees reads fall back to SQL; the fidelity check behind it is unit-tested in test_write_cost)

serial_fold.about: a parallel section runs as one slice while the plan is parallel (a serial build)
serial_fold.xfail: the smoke kernel builds in ~10 ms on the subset, under the 0.2 s floor where quick_check judges build scaling (that check is unit-tested in test_check_measure and caught the q3b serial build on the real tree)
serial_fold.escaped: gate complete: quick_check \(gate\) status=pass|\[repair\] code failure in gate:quick_check

data_race.about: a data race in the maintenance path; the agent's thread-sanitizer quick_check reports it
expect: \[tool quick_check\].*sanitizer report\(s\) with a frame in the query's own directory

heavy_gate_first.about: the agent asks for a heavy gate without a passing quick_check

dismissed_check.about: the agent sees its quick_check fail, calls it a budget matter and ends its turn; the exit batch's quick_check catches it

false_blocker.about: the agent reports a slow gate as a blocker; the stage's own gates run and pass, the stage completes
expect: the agent reported a blocker \(.*\); running the stage's gates once

real_blocker.about: the agent reports a blocker while its code really fails quick_check; the stage's gates run once, the next round carries the blocker and the agent fixes its code
expect: the agent reported a blocker \(.*\); running the stage's gates once
the agent reported a blocker \(.*\); it adapts in this round

primitive_extension.about: the agent extends a published primitive with an additive API; the publisher rebuilds the dependents and publishes

stalled.about: no edits: the footer nudges, the watchdog ends the turn, the advisor is consulted

no_units_probe.about: analysis without a simulated read per candidate; the validation message reaches the analysis session

one_primitive.about: analysis holds every state component in one mega-primitive; the validation message reaches the analysis session
